title.narrative: Bihar State Highways II Project - Additional Financing

description.narrative: The project will expand the original Bihar State Highways II Project "Original Project" output by rehabilitating and upgrading about 254 km of state highways in Bihar identified under the Bihar State Highways Development Program (BSHDP). These severely deteriorated highway sections are located in the very poor north and south parts of the state. The project will involve upgrading existing roads to two lanes, strengthening existing pavement, strengthening culverts and bridges, and constructing new bridges and cross-draining structures. Consulting services are provided to supervise the implementation of civil works. Completion of spillover works under Loan 2663-IND: Bihar State Highways II Project (closed on 30 September 2018) for the construction and upgrading of about 389 km of state highways have been included under the scope utilizing the loan surplus.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 2894: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 21 Nov 2022

Progress Toward Outcome: The improved transport efficiency and safety on completed project road achieved (State Highway 83). The works on remaining contract packages (3 No.) are in various stages of implementation.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Oct 2018: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/44425/44425-013-apfs-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | May 2016: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//44425-013-iee-05.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Nov 2011: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//44425-013-ind-rp-02.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Sep 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41629/41629-013-44425-013-smr-en_2.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: The civil works for construction and up gradation of 254 km state highways awarded under 4 contract packages during September-October 2013. Works on 1 contract package are completed, works remaining 3 contract packages are in various stages of implementation. The works are supervised by two supervision consultants.
Government of Bihar initiated measures for improving maintenance of roads.
Road Master Plan for Bihar's State Highway Development has been prepared under TA8170. Activities under this TA are completed within the closing date of 31 Dec 2015.
The Road Safety Specialist conducted exhaustive reviews of field conditions and produced road safety audits for Bihar State Highways.
